dataset.name: Pretreatment metastatic melanoma (Gide, 2019)
dataset.description: Independent metastatic melanoma immunotherapy cohort with pretreatment bulk RNA-seq and treatment-anchored survival outcomes.
dataset.cohort_context: Treatment-selected metastatic melanoma treated with anti-PD-1 monotherapy or combined anti-PD-1 and anti-CTLA-4 therapy. Only source-labelled pretreatment biopsies are retained.

metadata.treatment_context: Anti-PD-1 monotherapy or combined anti-PD-1 and anti-CTLA-4 therapy
metadata.curation_note: The source profile contains 91 RNA-seq biopsies from 75 patients. Eighteen on-treatment biopsies are excluded, leaving one pretreatment profile for each of 73 endpoint-complete patients.

expression.label: Provided log2 upper-quartile normalized counts
expression.duplicate_feature_rationale: Repeated rows with the same supplied symbol are averaged sample-wise; different identifiers are never merged implicitly.
expression.scale_note: The DataHub molecular-profile metadata identifies the frozen source values as log2 upper-quartile normalized counts. TRACE Explorer preserves that supplied scale.

endpoints.label: Overall survival
endpoints.time_origin: Start of the source-recorded immune-checkpoint regimen

endpoints.label: Progression-free survival
endpoints.time_origin: Start of the source-recorded immune-checkpoint regimen
endpoints.event_definition: Progression or death as encoded by the source PFS status
